subject: why packing long/short documents together (PP level) and sharding a packed sequence (CP level) both create uneven GPU workload

groups.why_chosen: Same worker pipeline drawn twice, coloured red vs green, making an abstract 'imbalance' concrete as one heavier micro-batch; the other panel maps a chunk onto the mask rows it touches.
groups.what_to_learn: Draw the same worker pipeline twice, colouring only the rows that differ (red = heavy micro-batch, green = light) to make 'imbalance' visible at a glance; elsewhere, map a chunk's label directly onto the mask rows it occupies.
